body:
An unchecked Min Clearance override routed a project with `Default.clearance = 0.0` at 0.25 mm in the GUI while the routing CLI used the physical 0.10-mm floor. The GUI now retains the declared-zero base and applies the same physical fab floor; an unavailable class uses the shared default, independently of a stale unchecked control.

Capacitor placement repair also consumed this shared routing value. Its caller now preserves an omitted placement override so that the placement engine retains its independent 0.25-mm fallback. Checked placement overrides, routing ceilings, nondefault classes and the distinct hole-spacing fallback retain their existing contracts. No placement engine, strategy, fabrication table or writer policy changes.

Closes #966

Validation:

- Independent reproduction on copies of the public `flat_hierarchy` board and project: baseline CLI/GUI 0.10/0.25 becomes 0.10/0.10; the unmodified Default-0.20 control stays 0.20/0.20. All eight baseline/final actual CLI and GUI-plan runs wrote boards with identical native copper, connected the selected net, and preserved 64 footprints, 247 pads, five outline items and complete `net_settings`.
- Independent final verification: 224 native parameter assertions on two-/four-layer boards; actual cap-engine pricing checks; fresh CLI/GUI output boards inspected with native KiCad DRC and connectivity. Inline and standalone cap repair, explicit overrides, ceilings, stale controls, nanometre boundaries and fab overrides are covered.
- Focused regression gates passed: #966, #768 (45 engine tests plus real dialog), #772, #782, geometry reset, manifest/plan parity, CLI post-pass coverage, #530 class/ceiling, #493 conversion and fab tiers.
- Existing full routing-chain control: exact native equality of 1,078 segments and 128 vias; zero native unconnected items. Five inherited mounting-pad edge errors remain. The old harness's `-1` grading sentinels were rejected as evidence and replaced by direct DRC/connectivity and native checks.

Final integrated revision: `acbcfa898f011f976632625194410d5fae8cccd5`; verified production revision: `e5681428d43a17f663df257b9a94c55c544e786c`. The final commit contains evidence only, with production-tree identity independently checked. Base: `5a7fbcb6ee4deebd1d9ec1d5bd094d8681f502f3` (`main`).

[Commands, effective parameters and geometry evidence](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/blob/acbcfa898f011f976632625194410d5fae8cccd5/docs/evidence/issue966/README.md) · [Independent reproduction](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/blob/acbcfa898f011f976632625194410d5fae8cccd5/docs/evidence/issue966/REPRODUCTION.md) · [Independent final findings](https://github.com/edgehero/KiCadRoutingTools/blob/acbcfa898f011f976632625194410d5fae8cccd5/docs/evidence/issue966/FINAL-VERIFICATION.md)

The final verifier caught an intermediate cap-placement regression (0.25 -> 0.10); it was corrected and affected checks rerun before publication. The focused boards retain inherited DRC violations and unrelated open nets, so they are not globally clean. Saved-fill native DRC also reports three NPTH/zone hole violations on both baseline and final CLI outputs; the verifier reran the same final file with zone refill, which removes those findings. This reconciles the differently flagged audits without changing a rule or suppressing a finding.

This reproduces the reader mismatch, not the historical DDR3 boxing/rip-up symptom. Unset-class writeback and other existing CLI/GUI project differences remain outside this reader fix; no universal projectless parity or PCB-quality improvement is claimed. The full suite and historical DDR3 bench were not run.
title: Fix unset routing clearance parity while preserving cap placement rules
